what: Approve the 2017 financial plan in principle (includes the 0.7-mill increase for RCMP costs)
result: Carried (count not audible; two members stated they were voting against)
reasons_against: Both objected to the Performing Arts Centre capital line and borrowing, not to policing costs; Zwaagstra called the RCMP increase out of council's control.

what: Adopt the 2018 financial plan (0.16-mill increase, attributed by the mover mainly to the RCMP cost share rising to 90%)
for: Cari Penner; John Fehr; Jac Siemens; Chris Goertzen
against: Michael Zwaagstra; Susan Penner; Earl Funk
reasons_against: Opponents objected to a $500,000 golf course land deal in the budget and said the RCMP increase had already been covered by the 2017 tax increase; none opposed policing spending itself.
